name: Whether a reader's recollection of a work holds against the work

values.gloss: the work argues what the reader says it argues
the work argues part of it, or with a qualification the reader omits
the work argues otherwise on the matter
the held work does not treat the matter
the work is not held, or the held pages do not carry the matter

note: The fidelity audit's verdicts (fidelity_verdicts) judge citation practice; these judge a recollection. Seeded 2026-09-06 for the Stacks' references lane.
